text: Resonates with the power from Elite Murloc Warrior, after a short chant, deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>.

Consumes 30 Courage to reel in the spinning lance and unleash a final piercing strike. The spiraling gust tears through the air, dealing sustained Attack DMG to enemies within range. The initial strike inflicts a 50% Wound on the target, lasting 10s.

Tips: Whenever you have enough Courage, use it on your most important skill.

Launches into enemy lines, dealing Attack DMG to enemies in range and knocking them Airborne. Restores 100 Courage.

"Endless storm, unlock thy mighty power at my knight's command! Wind, reveal thy glory with a surging rush!"

Tips: Cast when Courage is low.

Consumes 35 Courage to leap into the air and deliver a downward strike on the enemy, dealing Attack DMG.
"Even if enemy lines are unbreakable, the wind of victory will tear them asunder!"

Tips: Cast when Courage is near cap. When casting in succession, the leap is skipped for faster follow-up attacks.

A thrust followed by a backward leap releasing strong wind pressure, dealing Attack DMG equal to 380% ATK to enemies (which scales with the Level/Tier of Basic Attack).
After casting, immediately restores 20 Courage.

Summons a seed to strike enemies, dealing Magic DMG and reducing their Move SPD by 30%. While dealing DMG, the seed restores a total of 30 Energy.
This skill holds 2 charges.

Tips: Casting is advised when Energy is low.

Blade Intent
Stacks 2 Blade Intent per second. When fully charged, Special Attack is enhanced: Consumes 100 Blade Intent to greatly increase its casting speed.

Basic Attack: Swift Justice
Unleashes up to four sweeping strikes in longsword form, each dealing Attack DMG.

Tips: Use the Special Attack promptly when Blade Intent reaches the max to maximize damage.

Enchants the blade with thunderous power. While active, any action that would grant Thunder Sigils would instantly maxes them out. Also increases ATK and grants Super Armor for the duration.

Tips: Best paired with Overdrive and Talents to rapidly gain and spend Thunder Sigils, unleashing massive DMG within a short window.

Adopts a defensive stance, granting immunity to all damage for its duration. If struck, executes a rapid forward slash and jumps back. Activating the skill again performs a Dashing Slash forward, dealing Attack DMG. Grants max Thunder Sigils if the attack hits a target.

Tips: Using this skill in high-pressure situations or during familiar combat encounters yields a higher number of Thunder Sigils.

Charges ahead with immense force. Upon hit, gains 25 Rage and 1 Sand Crystal, deals Attack DMG, and stuns the enemy. Becomes unstoppable during the execution of the charge.
This skill holds 2 charges.

Tips: This skill enhances mobility and accumulates Rage quickly.

Creates a rocky barrier around yourself, automatically countering Lethal Skills for a period of time and increasing Block DMG Reduction. Each Sand Crystal consumed extends the duration by 1s (up to 5s).

Tips: Time carefully and use it during massive incoming Attack DMG to maximize Block DMG Reduction and minimize DMG taken.

Unleashes holy energy to strike nearby enemies, dealing Attack DMG and inflicting Dazzle for 5s. Grants a Radiant Shield equal to 300% ATK. For the next 10s, instantly refreshes 1 Holy Sigil for every 2s (prioritizing the Holy Sigil with the longest remaining CD), and generates 10 Photon Energy each time.

Radiant Shield: Infuses the Shield with light, absorbing 50% of incoming DMG. The effect can stack absorption and reset duration when the Skill is reused. Max absorption cannot exceed 100% of Max HP.

Tips: Instantly boosts survivability and generates Holy Sigil and Photon Energy. Time the casts wisely.

Summons Aegis Ward to shield yourself, automatically countering Lethal Skills while increasing Armor and DMG Reduction. If you take lethal DMG while this effect is active, the effect is consumed to prevent death and immediately restore 25% HP.

Tips: Powerful Resistance effect combined with death prevention, extremely valuable when facing extreme survival threats.

Gathers surrounding energy to pull all enemies within 30 meters to you, inflicting taunt.
Gain DMG Reduction for a period of time.
Passive Effect:Thorn.
Raises an energy shield in front to block enemies' <linktext=1068><style="ItemQuality_5">projectiles</style></linktext>.

[Boss Summon] - Crimson Foxen. Strike instantly, dealing 1 instance of <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>. Then it continues assisting the player in combat for <style="accent-gn">15s</style>. Can be directed via Storm Arrow from the Marksman.

[Boss Summon] - Dogorman. Transforms into Boss Dogorman and let out a roar, summoning a sandstone field that follows you for 10s. Grants DMG Reduction to allies in the field.
[Non-stackable. Only one effect of the same type may be active]

Resonates with the power of Boss: Goblin King, summoning 1–3 goblins at random to cast skills.
Always summons 1 from Elite: Goblin Guard or Elite: Goblin Warrior.
Has a chance to additionally summon 1 Elite: Jungle Goblin Warrior.
Has a chance to summon 1 from Elite: Storm Goblin Axe or Boss: Storm Goblin King. Has a 30% chance to summon the Boss.

Summons Fafala to create a field.
You and allies within the field gain Final DMG Reduction and Super Armor. When you deal damage from inside the field, inflict bonus damage based on a percentage of your DEF (can trigger at most once every 1s). When you take damage, reduce the CD of this Skill by 1s (can trigger at most once every 2s).
[This effect does not stack. Only one instance of this effect can be active at a time.

<style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Elite: Goblin Trickster to channel for a long time before dealing massive AoE <style="magic">Magic DMG</style>. (This skill damages enemies and up to <style="accent-gn">20</style> allies!)

Summons Elite: Goblin Shaman to briefly channel before summoning an exploding magic orb. The explosion deals Magic DMG to targets in the area and heals up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates).
After casting, for 20s, you deal damage every 2s to the surrounding area equal to 50% of the self-healing from your Class Skills.

<style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Elite: Ruthless Cabbage to randomly call down <style="accent-gn">1-3</style> bolts of simulated lightning, dealing <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> to targets in the area.

Summons Plague Nappo. The Nappo's attack method and skill effects change based on the type of skill cast previously.
If cast directly or after a Special Attack, summons Stormblade Nappo to deal AoE Attack DMG once, and reduces the current Resonance Skill's CD by 81.25%.
If cast after an Expertise Skill, summons Marksman Nappo to deal Attack DMG to a single target, and reduces the current Resonance Skill's CD by 68.75%.
If cast after an Ultimate, summons Wind Knight Nappo to deal Attack DMG once, reduces the current Resonance Skill's CD by 25%, and temporarily increases your DMG.
If cast after another Resonance Skill, summons Beat Performer Nappo to reduce the CD of the previously cast Resonance Skill (excluding this one).
Hold to charge, release to jump forward. Jump to the sky~
Feel the roar of the mech's engine! Increases Speed after use.
A wondrous gift from another world! Briefly increases movement speed after use.
Hold to activate the Hyper Impulse to perform a high-risk stunt. Release at the perfect moment to dash forward and reset the CD of Blazing Dash.
Surge toward the nebula! Upon casting, instantly resets Nebula Glide's CD. For a short time afterward, successive casts of Nebula Glide won't trigger CD.
Twist the throttle and feel that joyful roar! Dashes forward and increases Movement SPD.
Ice and snow crystallize into frost, paving a dreamlike path into the sky!
Sway and drift along the trade winds. Upon casting, run forward, continuously accelerating. Tap again to end the skill.

Consumes 10 HP to attack with Denvel's greatsword.
If the attack hits a Stalker, restores 50 HP.
Killing a Stalker fully restores HP.
Cannot be used when HP is insufficient.
The actual damage is calculated based on the Armor of the object the Stalker has transformed into.
Weapon Special Effect: Fires 2 additional blades of energy and clears all non-player objects within range.
"With this, I purge the sorrows of the past."

Consumes 10 HP to attack with Fafala's sword.
If the attack hits a Stalker, restores 50 HP.
Killing a Stalker fully restores HP.
Cannot be used when HP is insufficient.
The actual damage is calculated based on the Armor of the object the Stalker has transformed into.
Weapon Special Effect: Nearby Stalkers continuously restore HP and gain increased movement speed.
"I hope this brings you some peace..."

Consumes 10 HP to attack with a Pickaxe.
If the attack hits a Stalker, restores 50 HP.
Killing a Stalker fully restores HP.
Cannot be used when HP is insufficient.
The actual damage is calculated based on the Armor of the object the Stalker has transformed into.
Weapon Special Effect: Grants a random piece of ore on attack:
33% chance to obtain Amber: Reduces all skill CDs by 0.5s;
33% chance to obtain Benitoite: Restores 50 HP;
33% chance to obtain Dragon Crystal: Fires 5 energy blades in all directions;
1% chance to obtain Fulgurite: Lightning strikes all Stalkers within 30m.
"Do I have to dig too?"
